role: Business Intelligence Engineer, Data and Analytics

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: The ideal candidate will be comfortable in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Delivery and testing responsibilities ('Creation of test cases', 'stable and scalable system') are balanced against explicit velocity framing ('fast-paced, dynamic environment', 'Delivery of 1-2 main projects in parallel'), producing a mixed classification.
evidence.domain_risk: working intensely with his (larger) project team, including Finance
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role touches Finance and supply chain operational decisions but there is no explicit financial reporting, audit, or regulatory compliance language, keeping it at moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Our Data and Analytics team continuously invests on people development, systems integration and tools automation
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: This is Amazon's established EU Supply Chain Data and Analytics team with existing systems and processes to integrate into, indicating a mature, specialized function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Sagemaker, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The qualifications section names specific tools and services precisely, but the responsibilities section is largely generic boilerplate ('Analysis of business requirements', 'Focus on project delivery'), giving a mixed authorship signal.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Our Data and Analytics team continuously invests on people development, systems integration and tools automation
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's output serves the internal Data and Analytics function and its tooling/reporting infrastructure rather than one specific commercial or product team.
evidence.autonomy_level: By support of senior colleagues integration into a working, stable and scalable system
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Responsibilities describe receiving business requirements and delivering scoped projects under senior guidance rather than setting direction, placing this at execution level.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The opening line mentions 'artificial intelligence' only as a general interest/passion question, with no responsibility or requirement expecting the candidate to use or build AI tooling.
evidence.testing_framing: Creation of test cases and guidance of business stakeholders within the testing process
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is named as an owned responsibility with an ownership verb ('Creation of test cases and guidance'), not just a listed skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed around delivery, project ownership, and capability with no risk register, compliance, or trust-recovery language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Independent realization of requirements for Business Intelligence and custom software development products
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities mix building new BI/software products with maintaining and fixing deployed solutions ('Ownership of maintenance and error handling'), giving a mixed signal.
